body:
dump your brain. sloth sorts it.

local Gemma 3 via Ollama - zero cost - works offline
your words never leave your machine

Hacktoberfest 2026 - Week 3: Slow and Steady
title: Sloth - the lazy task triager

body:
$ cat examples/brain-dump.txt

fix the leaking kitchen sink before mom visits friday
URGENT: reply to client about the invoice, they asked twice already
buy milk and eggs
maybe learn how sourdough works someday
lol

prepare slides for monday standup
idea: build a sloth-themed task app
call bank about the weird charge

title: the messy input

body:
$ python sloth.py triage examples/brain-dump.txt

[gemma3:1b thinking locally...]
